controles.affirmation: Action de recours collectif engagee le 23 juin 2026 devant l'Eastern District de New York (Claire Day), periode d'achat 26 fevrier 2025 - 24 fevrier 2026, allegations de declarations trompeuses sur la capacite a gerer l'impact de la politique tarifaire ; First Solar conteste et ne peut estimer de perte
controles.verbatim_source: A securities class action lawsuit was commenced in the United States District Court for the Eastern District of New York on June 23, 2026, by Claire Day... on behalf of all persons and entities that purchased or otherwise acquired First Solar securities between February 26, 2025 and February 24, 2026... failed to disclose material information regarding our capacity to manage the impact of U.S. tariff policy on our business, and understated the extent to which our responses to U.S. tariff policy were likely to negatively impact projected performance in 2026... We dispute the allegations and intend to defend the action vigorously. At this time, we are not in a position to assess the likelihood of any potential loss... (10-Q T2 2026, Note 11 Legal Proceedings)

controles.affirmation: Plainte derivee d'actionnaires (Manh Ho) deposee le 28 juillet 2026 sur des faits similaires
controles.verbatim_source: On July 28, 2026, based on allegations substantially similar to the above-described securities class action, a shareholder derivative lawsuit was commenced in the United States District Court for the Eastern District of New York by Manh Ho... (10-Q T2 2026, Note 11)

controles.affirmation: Litige BP Solar / Lightsource : assignation en septembre 2025, penalites contractuelles de 384,6 M$, 61,0 M$ reconnus en revenu, 323,6 M$ reclames ; contre-plaintes de 175 M$ plus 15 M$ ; audience sur la demande de rejet le 29 juillet 2026
controles.verbatim_source: On September 30, 2025, First Solar filed a complaint in the Supreme Court of the State of New York asserting that BP Solar Holding LLC and its affiliate Lightsource Renewable Energy Trading, LLC... triggered certain contractual termination payment provisions amounting to $384.6 million, of which First Solar recognized $61.0 million in revenue during the quarter... demanding payment from the Defendants for the remaining termination payments of $323.6 million... Defendants' have demanded damages in the amount of $175 million plus the return of $15 million credit support taken by First Solar... Oral argument of the Motion to Dismiss has been scheduled for July 29, 2026. (10-Q T2 2026, Item 1 Legal Proceedings)
controles.correction_proposee: Deux precisions de vocabulaire : (1) Lightsource est designee comme 'affiliate' de BP Solar Holding, pas comme 'filiale' ; (2) les 15 M$ sont un 'credit support taken by First Solar' (soutien de credit appele par First Solar), la formulation 'garantie retenue' est approximative.

controles.affirmation: En fevrier 2026, la Cour supreme a juge illegaux les droits IEEPA imposes en 2025, ouvrant un processus de remboursement dont le montant final peut differer de maniere materielle
controles.verbatim_source: On February 20, 2026, the U.S. Supreme Court ruled the IEEPA tariffs unlawful. Since that ruling, the U.S. Court of International Trade ordered U.S. Customs and Border Protection to commence the process of refunding IEEPA tariffs. The refunds we ultimately recover may differ from the full amount we previously paid, and that difference may be material. (10-Q T2 2026)

controles.affirmation: En juillet 2026, un nouveau tarif de 10% a ete impose au titre de la Section 301 sur plusieurs pays fournisseurs de First Solar, dont la Malaisie, l'Inde et l'Union europeenne
controles.verbatim_source: ...which terminated on July 24, 2026, at which time the USTR implemented a final action under Section 301 of the Trade Act of 1974... The USTR imposed an effective tariff of 10% on several countries, including Malaysia, India, and the EU, and an effective tariff of 12.5% on the remaining countries, including China and Vietnam. (10-Q T2 2026)

controles.affirmation: Marge brute de 57,3% au T2 2026 contre 45,6% un an plus tot, dont un benefice net ponctuel de 88,6 M$ lie aux remboursements IEEPA attendus
controles.verbatim_source: Gross profit as a percentage of net sales increased 11.7 percentage points to 57.3% during the three months ended June 30, 2026 from 45.6% during the three months ended June 30, 2025. The increase was primarily due to (i) an $88.6 million net benefit related to expected IEEPA tariff refunds less estimated amounts payable to customers... (10-Q T2 2026)
controles.correction_proposee: Le mot 'record' (hook et resume) n'apparait nulle part dans le 10-Q. Il n'est verifiable que sur la serie interne kpis-haut, qui commence au T2 2014 : 57,3% y est bien le plus haut niveau des 49 trimestres disponibles (2e : 50,2% au T3 2024). Ecrire 'plus haut niveau depuis au moins 2014' plutot que 'record'.

controles.affirmation: Le credit d'impot Section 45X est un 'element ponctuel' qui a reduit le cout des ventes de 70,7 M$ sur le trimestre ; en retirant les deux effets (environ 15 points de marge), la marge organique est proche de son niveau de l'an dernier (45,6%)
controles.verbatim_source: Cost of sales decreased $146.1 million, or 24.5%... This decrease was primarily driven by (i) expected IEEPA tariff refunds...; (ii) A HIGHER VOLUME of modules sold qualifying for the advanced manufacturing production credit under Section 45X of the IRC, WHICH DECREASED COST OF SALES BY $70.7 MILLION; and (iii) decreased logistics costs of $35.6 million. (10-Q T2 2026, Cost of Sales)
controles.correction_proposee: Trois defauts. (1) Le credit 45X n'est pas un element ponctuel : c'est un credit de production recurrent, lie aux volumes fabriques aux Etats-Unis (le 10-Q parle d''advanced manufacturing PRODUCTION credit'), et la serie interne le chiffre a 1,6 Md$ sur un an. (2) Les 70,7 M$ ne sont pas le benefice 45X du trimestre, mais la VARIATION du benefice liee a la hausse des volumes par rapport au T2 2025 : le montant total du credit sur le trimestre est bien superieur. (3) Le calcul est incoherent : retirer 15 points de 57,3% donne 42,2%, soit MOINS que les 45,6% de l'an dernier, et non 'proche'. En ne retirant que l'element reellement ponctuel (88,6 M$ = 8,4 points de marge sur 1 056,2 M$ de CA), la marge hors IEEPA ressort a environ 48,9%, soit encore +3,3 points sur un an. Reecrire l'argument sur cette base.

controles.verbatim_source: Net sales 1,056,193 / 1,097,170 (trimestre) et 2,100,433 / 1,941,738 (semestre) ; Net income 769,188 / 551,403 (semestre) (10-Q T2 2026, compte de resultat condense)

controles.affirmation: Carnet de commandes contracte de 45,1 GW / 13,6 Mds$ au 30 juin 2026, en baisse de 27% et 26% sur un an, contre un pic de 78,3 GW fin 2023 debut 2024, soit -42% en deux ans et demi
controles.verbatim_source: .batches-drafts-safe/kpis-haut/FSLR.json : contracted_backlog_gw value 45.1, yoy -27% ; contracted_backlog_bn value 13.6, yoy -26% ; historique Q4-2023 78,3 et Q1-2024 78,3 (maximum de la serie). 45,1/78,3 = -42,4%. A noter : le mot 'backlog' n'apparait pas dans le 10-Q T2 2026, le chiffre ne vient donc pas du document SEC.
controles.correction_proposee: Preciser dans les sources que le carnet de commandes provient de la communication trimestrielle de la societe et non du 10-Q cite.

controles.affirmation: Le carnet de commandes recule pour un HUITIEME trimestre consecutif
controles.verbatim_source: Historique contracted_backlog_gw (kpis-haut FSLR) : Q1-2024 78,3 puis Q2-2024 74,6 ; Q3-2024 72,8 ; Q4-2024 68,5 ; Q1-2025 66,1 ; Q2-2025 61,9 ; Q3-2025 53,7 ; Q4-2025 50,1 ; Q1-2026 47,9 ; Q2-2026 45,1. Soit NEUF trimestres consecutifs de baisse depuis le pic du T1 2024.
controles.correction_proposee: Remplacer 'huitieme trimestre consecutif' par 'neuvieme trimestre consecutif' (ou 'plus de deux ans de baisse ininterrompue'). L'erreur apparait deux fois : dans le resume et dans le titre du bloc quantitatif.

controles.affirmation: 701,9 M$ de credits 45X generes en 2025 monetises pour 668,1 M$ de tresorerie, en plus de 818,6 M$ percus au titre de 2024
controles.verbatim_source: In December 2024, we entered into two agreements for the sale of $857.2 million of Section 45X tax credits we generated during 2024 for aggregate cash proceeds of $818.6 million... In June 2025 and July 2025, we entered into two agreements for the sale of $701.9 million of Section 45X tax credits we generated during 2025 for aggregate cash proceeds of $668.1 million. (10-Q T2 2026)

controles.affirmation: La loi H.R.1 de juillet 2025 restreint l'eligibilite au credit 45X en cas de recours a un fournisseur lie a une entite etrangere preoccupante (FEOC) et accelere la fin des credits ITC et PTC solaires
controles.verbatim_source: ...in July 2025, the U.S. President signed H.R.1 into law... which significantly curtails the availability of certain energy tax credits. H.R.1 includes accelerating the termination of the clean electricity Investment Tax Credit ('ITC') and Production Tax Credit ('PTC') in relation to solar and restricting tax credits if a taxpayer employs certain products and components produced by a supplier with ties to a foreign entity of concern ('FEOC'). H.R.1 also severely limits Section 45X tax credit eligibility for products manufactured by, or with material assistance from, a FEOC. (10-Q T2 2026)

controles.affirmation: Sixieme usine americaine en Caroline du Sud, demarrage prevu au second semestre 2026
controles.verbatim_source: ...the construction of our sixth U.S. manufacturing facility in South Carolina to onshore final production processes for modules initiated by our international fleet, with the first phase expected to commence operations in the second half of 2026. (10-Q T2 2026)
controles.correction_proposee: Preciser qu'il s'agit du demarrage de la PREMIERE PHASE de l'usine, pas de l'usine entiere.
